answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops a sybil wandering the economy under fake names. Each agent wanting a slot burns 500 POA for a 20-epoch seat; no velvet rope to slip past. A forger holding 1,000 slots pays 500,000 POA, and the burn is final. Like karst ground, cheap copies collapse: each extra identity needs its own slot, so flooding the market costs more than the reward. An honest agent pays once, holds its slot 20 epochs, and earns undiluted fees.
